scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @petmore/api" "npm run dev -w @petmore/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @petmore/api && npm run build -w @petmore/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @petmore/api && npm run typecheck -w @petmore/web
